[[File:Scavenger Format tuskens scavenging.png|thumb|right|260px|Scavenger Format graphic. Players Committee.]]
'''Scavenger Format''' is a Players Committee constructed format using only Decipher cards of common rarities.<ref name="pc-scav">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/scavenger/ Scavenger Format], starwarsccg.org.</ref> On [[GEMP]] the environment is named Scavenger (code <code>scavenger_premiere_ds2</code>), covering printed sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]]. Banned rarities are Ultra Rare (UR), Rare (R), Rare (R1), Rare (R2), Exclusive Rare (XR), Premium (PM), and Preview (PV).<ref name="pc-scav" /><ref name="gemp">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/master/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public), GitHub.</ref>

The [[2025 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase]] and [[2026 Scrapyard Scrum]] are published Scavenger Format events on GEMP. [[PDS2 interviews]] covered the format with [[Mike Shumaker]] (22 April 2025) and [[Micah Fleetwood]] (26 April 2025).
